title: Critical Java vulnerability discovered; NIS issues urgent inspection advisory to public institutions

 🌐 日本語 · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · العربية · Français · বাংলা · Русский · Deutsch Shin Jung-hwan Reporter 입력 2026.11.17 23:35 업데이트 2026.11.18 07:46 ( 연합뉴스 ) Oracle has released 652 new security patches covering a wide range of enterprise software, including databases, middleware, and financial and human resources management solutions. These include vulnerabilities with the maximum CVSS 10.0 severity rating and others that can be exploited remotely without authentication, requiring prompt action from customers.
 Security patches applied to major product lines
 Oracle announced its Critical Security Patch Update (CSPU) for November 2026 on the 17th. This update broadly covers database servers, enterprise business applications, middleware, analytics tools, and financial and human resources management solutions.
 Targeted products include Oracle's major enterprise product lines such as Fusion Middleware, Oracle Analytics, Hyperion, E-Business Suite, and Java. Oracle explained that this update is a separate release focused on high-risk vulnerabilities, complementing existing quarterly cumulative security updates.
 Includes vulnerabilities exploitable remotely
 Fusion Middleware receives 71 patches. Of these, 53 address vulnerabilities that can be exploited remotely over a network without separate user authentication. Fusion Middleware is foundational software used to run and connect various business applications within an enterprise.
 Fusion Middleware and Oracle Analytics also contain vulnerabilities with a score of 10.0, the highest on the Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) 3.1 scale. The CVSS score represents the level of risk based on the attack complexity and potential impact of a vulnerability, with 10.0 being the highest risk level.
 Hyperion and E-Business Suite also targeted
 By product, 267 patches were allocated to Hyperion, a financial and business planning management solution, and 72 patches to E-Business Suite, which integrates accounting, procurement, and human resources tasks. There are 11 security patches related to Java.
 The database server includes 7 new security patches, 3 of which can be exploited remotely over a network without authentication. The highest CVSS score among the database server vulnerabilities is 9.9.
 Oracle recommends prompt application
 Oracle has advised customers to apply the updates without delay. The CSPU is provided to customers with valid Oracle support contracts, and each company must apply the patches appropriate for the products and versions they are using.
 Starting in 2026, Oracle has been operating the CSPU to respond to high-risk vulnerabilities separately from existing quarterly CPUs. In September of this year, 673 new security patches were announced for the CSPU, and 1,295 new security patches were released in the October quarterly CPU.
